findings.description: The `if not top: return "none"` branch in _coverage_failure_detail is unreachable because check 6 only invokes it when coverage is below 60%, which guarantees uncovered lines exist; the dead code has no guard comment.
'%d lines' is used unconditionally, so a single uncovered line renders as '1 lines'.
Assertions are broad substrings checking only file-name presence, not exact line counts or ordering.
